about: Judge instructions used to collect the verdict matrices in data/matrices/. Each template is filled with str.format(): {parent_A}, {reply_A}, {parent_B}, {reply_B} receive the texts with whitespace collapsed, and {root_note} receives the top-level-comment note in the instruction's language when the collection runs with root_clause=True (an empty string otherwise). Template files are UTF-8; the loader converts CRLF to LF and drops one final newline.

relevance_v2.note: Relevance of the reply to its parent comment; A or B only when the difference is obvious.

auth_v3.note: Authenticity: a live human reaction vs a bot reply, planted message or flaming. Also used unchanged on the English translation (GA2_en_ru). In the authors' logs and in results/ it is named relevance_v3.

auth_eng_v3.note: English version of auth_v3 with its structure and the order of its items preserved.

coh_eng_v1.note: Coherence of a dialogue response with its context, for the external P-DD set; collected without the top-level note.

ru.both: Учти: в обеих парах родительский текст — это описание видео, а реплай — комментарий первого уровня под роликом (не ответ на чужой комментарий). Оценивай связь реплая с темой ролика в целом, а не дословное соответствие описанию.
ru.one: Учти: в паре {side} родительский текст — это описание видео, а реплай — комментарий первого уровня под роликом (не ответ на чужой комментарий); оценивай его связь с темой ролика, а не дословное соответствие описанию.

en.both: Note: in both pairs the parent text is the video description, and the reply is a top-level comment under the video (not a reply to someone else's comment). Judge how the reply relates to the topic of the video as a whole, not its literal correspondence to the description.
en.one: Note: in pair {side} the parent text is the video description, and the reply is a top-level comment under the video (not a reply to someone else's comment); judge how it relates to the topic of the video, not its literal correspondence to the description.
